description: Ask up to 20 typed yes/no, multiple-choice or ordinal-scale questions about one shared piece of context in a single call - each answered with a real probability (Jev decision primitives), not generated text. Powered by Jev (TypeSafe System One). $0.001 per call, no OpenRouter or TypeSafe account needed. Try GET /decide/sample.

questions.description: Up to 20 typed questions, keyed by a name you choose. Each needs type ('noul', 'choice' or 'score'), instructions, and criteria (shape depends on type - see /decide/sample).

state.description: Shared context the questions are asked about - a string, or a JSON object/array. Capped at 8000 tokens.

name: decide

answers.description: One answer per question key, shaped by its type: noul (probability of yes), choice (selected option, per-option probabilities, confidence), or score (position, per-level probabilities, confidence, legend).

x402_receipt.description: Billing and provenance receipt for this call.

title: Decision Questions
